BLR Platform runtime: 20.45 s on average (14.74–27.57 s across 4 runs), with the payment gateway excluded. The slowest BLR step is Consent to TLPE at 6.63 s (32% of BLR time). Including the 3DS payment gateway, the full flow takes 45.32 s, so the gateway accounts for 55% of what a payer waits.
Read with care: the test environment was slower during this run. The payment gateway steps are the same TLPE/3DS pages for SWB and DWB, yet they took 24.88 s here vs 12.94 s in the SWB run the day before (PAY → 3DS 8.96 s vs 2.88 s). Run-to-run spread is also wide. Compare this baseline only with an after-enhancement run taken at a similar time, and do not compare it directly with the SWB baseline.

Method and notes

  • BLR Platform runtime = steps 1–5 and 8: payment page, form to Payment Summary, Consent, hand-off to TLPE Customer Details, TLPE Next to Confirm Payment, and the return to the Payment Posted receipt. Same split as the SWB baseline.
  • Payment gateway (excluded) = steps 6–7: PAY → 3DS Simulator, and Approve + Submit → TRANSACTION SUCCESSFUL.
  • Fresh visitor each run: new browser session with no cookies or cache.
  • Headed browser required: in headless Chromium, TLPE shows "Sorry, something went wrong" after PAY and never reaches 3DS.
  • Only posted runs count: if the receipt says Payment Posting Failed, the run repeats with a new amount. All 4 runs posted on the first attempt.
  • Possible bug found: clicking Next on the Payment Summary before the page finishes loading skips the Consent pop-up and goes straight to TLPE (same as SWB: the Consent handler is only attached once the page script has run).
  • After the code enhancement: run BENCH_LABEL=V1-enhanced BENCH_RUNS=4 with manila-water.benchmark.spec.ts at a similar time of day and compare the BLR Platform runtime against this baseline.
